concepts.title: Paper Garden
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity premium desktop WEBSITE HERO DESIGN CONCEPT for GentlePath, for parents and caregivers navigating autism. Horizontal 16:10 composition, approximately 1920 x 1200, crisp readable typography and real implementable web layout. Input Image 1 is a REFERENCE for the existing brand, wording, logo, navigation, and product purpose, not a layout to copy mechanically. This is a fresh art-directed visual exploration of that hero. Output only a single hero viewport with its header; no collage, multi-concept board, device frame, browser chrome, annotations, image labels, watermarks, task overlays or next-page sections.
Preserve brand: deep forest #174e46, deep green ink #123e39, warm ivory #faf8f2, paper #fffdf8; supporting sage and a little pale lavender and warm sunlight yellow. Lora-style refined editorial serif for the large headline with the second phrase in a beautiful controlled italic; DM Sans-style modern human sans for navigation, body, and controls. Use the G/P blocks brand mark from the reference beside "GentlePath". A tidy navigation with "How It Helps", "For Your Family", "Our Purpose", "Email Us", a pale lilac "Your Account" capsule with chevron, and a circular moon theme toggle. Realistically sized header and all interactive targets at least 44px.
Exact hero wording: small readable eyebrow "For Parents And Caregivers Navigating Autism"; headline "You’re Not Alone." and "Let’s Grow Together."; supporting text "Keep your family’s plans, progress, and everyday moments together. Set goals for your child, stay on top of applications and follow-ups, and find connection with parents who understand."; primary CTA "Find Your GentlePath" with a small right arrow; quieter secondary "See How It Helps" with a small down chevron. Optional quiet closing line uses "Your Family’s Own Way." and "A little more clarity for what’s next. More room for the moments that matter."
The hero must be reassuring, aspirational and genuinely useful. Have one unambiguous primary action, generous breathing room, excellent contrast, readable supporting copy, no overlapping UI. Respect family dignity. Do not imply cures or clinical diagnosis. No fake testimonials, fake usage statistics, invented awards, puzzle pieces, gradients on text, neon glows, lens flare, meaningless floating orbs, UI card confetti, tiny gray type or visual clutter. All text and CTAs fit visibly inside the viewport.
ART DIRECTION: A tactile PAPER GARDEN, the most natural premium evolution of the current page. A calm stacked centered headline on cream with immense controlled editorial scale, around 104px in a 1920px composition; the two headline phrases each on a line. Short centered paragraph beneath, then forest primary pill and text secondary. Slim forest header preserves identity.
Signature image treatment: bottom quarter and outer left/right margins form an exquisite panoramic sculpted PAPER LANDSCAPE, not watercolor: flowing ivory and muted sage layers cut like low hills, a warm ivory winding path from lower-left moving toward the center distance, and sparse elegant outlined leaves in sage, forest and lilac. Use 3-4 oversized paper botanical shapes, restrained raised edges and tiny soft contact shadows, sophisticated printmaking quality rather than cartoon. A lavender paper arch peeks from the far right behind a botanical silhouette; a small muted sunlight disc near an outer edge. The center behind the headline remains nearly plain ivory.
PATTERN: very fine, low-contrast debossed contour lines trace the winding-path motif only at the outer margins, fading gently before text; exquisite barely visible paper grain. Effects have a plausible CSS/SVG/transparent-image implementation, no heavy 3D. The botanical scene is visually strong at the edges without intruding into the reading zone. Integrate the bottom "Your Family’s Own Way." line as a slim elegant editorial caption along the pale path, not the original large yellow slab. This is a quiet luxury family brand, atmospheric, welcoming, and calm.

One gorgeous full-bleed editorial photograph fills the hero, with a candid parent and young child age about six exploring a sunlit meadow together. They are off-center in the right half, relaxed and present in a small ordinary moment, not looking at camera, no staged advertisement grins. Natural human anatomy, realistic textured clothing in cream and muted sage, soft film-like greens, afternoon side light, rich depth of field. Photo is premium authentic lifestyle editorial, not generic stock. Parent kneels beside child observing something in the grass, emotional connection through body language, no special labels attached to either person.
Composition is IMAGE-AS-CANVAS with headline in the lower-left and middle-left safe zone, not text/image columns: a sophisticated forest-green photographic grade and carefully feathered dark green overlay make the left 56 percent very calm and the right airy and luminous. The large two-line ivory serif headline stands out with exquisite contrast. Body in soft warm ivory, limited line length, no text on faces. Main CTA pale sunlight yellow with deep forest text; secondary ivory inline with restrained chevron. Header in forest at top with ivory navigation and lilac account button, visually integrates with the full-bleed scene.
PATTERN/EFFECT: one extremely subtle hairline winding path motif follows the lower image edge, almost like an editorial border, plus fine natural film grain. Avoid gratuitous UI panels or floating badges. Keep photography as the main visual, build clear cinematic contrast while retaining the warmth and accessibility of GentlePath. Bottom closing phrase may sit as a small quiet ivory caption with a thin dividing line. The photograph, not a rectangle pasted next to text, is the canvas.

ART DIRECTION: PREMIUM EDITORIAL FAMILY STORY. A confident INVERTED ASYMMETRIC LAYOUT, image anchored left and type on right. Ivory canvas, clean forest top header. In the lower-left 46 percent place a tall editorial photograph of a parent and child drawing together at a warm oak kitchen table, intimate candid moment, natural window light, soft sage curtains and warm tactile textures. Photo has a striking tall rounded arch top and very subtle asymmetric organic lower edge; no entire device or browser frame. It is large and beautiful, an architectural photograph window, not a small thumbnail. A narrow offset lavender matte paper shape behind the arch gives a beautiful 12px rim on one side. Cropping is generous enough to show natural hands, paper and interaction; emotionally real, refined, respectful and relaxed.
Right 48 percent holds eyebrow, very elegant forest serif headline split naturally into THREE spacious lines: "You’re Not Alone." on the first; italic "Let’s Grow" on the second and "Together." on third. Large enough to be art-directed, not crowded. Supporting paragraph under it with generous line spacing, then forest CTA and secondary text link in a clear action group. Body and buttons remain entirely on the clean cream.
PATTERN/EFFECT: large very faint botanical window shadows cross only the outer ivory margins; a single thin forest winding line emerges near the photo’s bottom edge and curves gently toward the CTA to imply a path, never crossing text. Exquisite understated paper grain and hairline editorial rules, no busy dot field. A small existing phrase "Your Family’s Own Way." is typeset as a serif photo caption with a little outlined leaf below the photo. Composition feels like a high-end independent journal or thoughtful family brand. Restrained, tangible, warm, polished, distinctive and fully functional.

ART DIRECTION: PRODUCT-LED QUIET CLARITY. Show the emotional headline AND what the family workspace actually does, in a spacious centered editorial hero. Cream canvas and crisp forest top navigation. Large centered two-line green serif heading in the top-middle; generous but efficient spacing keeps the paragraph and both CTA choices visible within upper 65 percent of the hero. Use refined lilac only as a pale ambient wash at the bottom, not a blue-purple tech gradient.
Signature visual: one beautifully rendered wide REALISTIC WEB APP PREVIEW occupying the bottom 30-35 percent of the hero, at a very slight 2-degree perspective tilt or perfectly straight, within one cream app shell with a forest side navigation and soft long shadow. It should be clearly one coherent application screenshot, not scattered cards. The shell has a tiny G/P GentlePath identity, sidebar labels "My Path", "Family", "Applications", "Goals", "Journal", "Community". The main content shows a concise "My Path" heading and three restrained practical regions: a near-term "Follow-Ups" entry with a calendar icon and clear action; an "Active" goal row under "Goals"; and a calm paper "Recent Reflections" area. Use plenty of readable whitespace and a sparse sage/lilac illustration. No charts, bar graphs, fake clinical metrics, banking UI, imaginary productivity scores, nested card stacks or excessive detail. This is a family’s practical private organizer, not an analytics product.
PATTERN/EFFECT: behind the app preview, two huge barely visible embossed path arcs rise from the lower-left in soft sage and ivory, suggesting continuity. A very small hint of warm sunlight yellow along one curved edge brings focus to the preview. Maintain clean text safe zones above. The first impression is elegant typography, the second is real product usefulness. The primary CTA remains the clearest interactive object. The preview is supporting marketing artwork, not a competing action. Beautiful luxury editorial meets useful family software.
